output.reason: The upgrade guide [ev-2df1b23f32ac] says the `experimental.http3` option has been removed, is now unsupported, and "would prevent Traefik to start". Its remediation is to remove `http3` from the experimental section of the static configuration. So 'none' hides a real startup failure for environments that still set the option. The changelog line [ev-177a6106bc02] only records the move out of the experimental section.

correction.statement: In Traefik v3.0.0, HTTP/3 is no longer experimental and the static `experimental.http3` option is removed. A static configuration that still sets this option is unsupported and prevents Traefik from starting.

consequence.statement: If the static configuration still sets the removed `experimental.http3` option, Traefik v3 does not start: the option is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik from starting.
consequence.remediation: Remove the `http3` option from the experimental section of the static configuration. HTTP/3 can be enabled on entry points without it.
